seo.title: AITS | All India Truckshed: Truck Wash and Trucking Infrastructure
seo.description: All India Truckshed (AITS) is building professional truck washing infrastructure for commercial fleets in India, starting with AITS Wash.

hero.title: Building India's Professional Truck Washing Infrastructure
hero.lead: AITS Wash is the first business vertical of All India Truckshed Infrastructure Private Limited.
hero.imageAlt: A loaded Indian goods truck driving on an open highway

about.title: Building the future of commercial trucking.
about.body: AITS is building the infrastructure layer that keeps India's commercial trucking ecosystem moving. The first step is AITS Wash: a professional wash infrastructure built specifically for commercial fleets, currently being planned.

problem.title: Truck washing is still largely informal, manual and untracked.

items.title: Manual Labour
items.text: Inconsistent cleaning, heavily dependent on individual effort

items.title: Driver Involvement
items.text: Drivers idle during wash, so vehicle downtime increases

items.title: Water Wastage
items.text: No recovery or treatment, with uncontrolled discharge

items.title: No Digital Records
items.text: No wash history, no fleet-level visibility, no centralized billing

cards.title: AITS Wash
cards.text: A professional wash infrastructure built specifically for commercial fleets.

cards.title: Fleet Program
cards.text: From individual washes to recurring fleet contracts, with one consolidated invoice for the entire fleet.

cards.title: AITS Vision
cards.text: From Truck Wash to Truck Infrastructure Network.
